test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains as error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

Playing in the field, the young __gayer __students were laughing and giggling.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. gay .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**gayer**" is not appropriately used in the given context. Instead, we need an adjective that appropriately describes the students' state of being happy and cheerful.
 
• The correct adjective in the sentence should be "**gay**," which means happy and cheerful.
 
• The alternative options (most gay, gayest, more gay) do not fit the context or appropriately modify the noun (students) in a grammatical sense.

Correct sentence: *Playing in the field, the young **gay** students were laughing and giggling*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Forms and Usage of "Gay":**

 
 
• **Gay:** Adjective - lighthearted and carefree.
 
• **Form Comparisons:**
 
 
• **Gay:** Positive form - used to describe someone who is happy.
 
• **Gayer:** Comparative form (less commonly used) - used to compare two things.
 
• **Gayest:** Superlative form (less commonly used) - used to compare more than two things.
